svg.title: Rezeks — contribution snake
svg.desc: Animated view of the public contribution calendar from 2025-11-02 to 2026-11-07. 109 contributions on 26 active days. The snake visits every day, eats the colored squares, and returns outside the calendar as the board resets. This is a decorative traversal, not the chronological order of contributions.
svg.text: A year of activity. One square at a time.
